Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the txn id. A couple of notes on Redwood's vendor onboarding path:

1) Preferred path: automated IRS/EIN verification (API) + matching legal name on our PII/TIN check. If the API returns a clean VERIFIED status we can move to provisional PO release (30% available) while we complete payment setup.
2) Contingency: if the API flags a name normalization or fuzzy-match (or returns NO-MATCH), we require either: a) a notarized W-9 (wet-ink notarization) OR b) a DocuSign envelope with signer identity attested + a one-time notarization video (we accept remote notarization in eligible states).

Could you confirm you authorize Redwood to perform an IRS API lookup for EIN 12-3456789? If yes, please reply with explicit consent line ("I authorize Redwood Inference to perform an IRS EIN verification for Clearwave Payments, EIN 12-3456789") so we have an audit trail. I've attached a short consent form (IRS_API_consent_form.pdf) you can sign and return.

If you want to avoid notarization, please confirm and we will run the lookup right away — also copy any alternate legal names (DBAs) that should be considered.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
